earlier_q_results.old_classifier_training_runs_preprocessi: unavailable; no persisted classifier artifact or provenance found

models.rung_0: clean M0 EEG-only SGDClassifier(loss=log_loss, penalty=l2, alpha=0.01, average=True), five streaming passes, class weights {0:1,1:5}
models.rung_1: same M0 with fixed alpha=0.1 local DistilGPT2 prior
models.other_rungs: dropped; Q strings are typed key sequences, not natural-language text

preprocessing.channels: all 32 Study Q EEG channels, locked training-cache order

calibration.method: scalar temperature scaling fitted to clean training-only OOF sequence membership-grid NLL

rung_1.context: teacher-forced previously typed target keys, mapped with the frozen special-key map; same convention as inner OOF

primary_estimand.name: as-recorded-depth character accuracy
primary_estimand.depth: use all valid sequences recorded for each character, with no extrapolation beyond the recorded depth

gate_g1.inner_estimand: clean nested OOF fused accuracy using every available sequence (10/character); differs from Test only through Test's naturally variable recorded depths
gate_g1.interpretation: A held-out fused accuracy more than 10 percentage points below inner OOF is flagged as a session-shift signal; this threshold is fixed before Test access.

accuracy_vs_depth_curves.bias_label: biased by early stopping and unequal recorded depth; descriptive only

depth_bucket_sensitivity.compare: fused minus EEG-only subject-level accuracy difference within each recorded-depth bucket
depth_bucket_sensitivity.purpose: check whether the sign of the primary gain changes across depth strata

statistics.paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, fused versus EEG-only
statistics.confidence_intervals: 95% bootstrap over subjects, resampling subjects with replacement
statistics.depth_bucket_sensitivity: report per-subject paired differences and subject-bootstrap 95% intervals
